fields.description: Status/mode byte heading the 16-byte player record validated by FUN_0803fe04 (fresh save: 0x00).
fields.evidence: FUN_0803fe04 loads 0x14 bytes via func_0x08098008 and validates with FUN_0803f9a4; FUN_0800a380 consumes the record after load.
fields.name: record_status

fields.description: 4-character tag stored in the player record (baseline: 'M6O5').
fields.evidence: Bytes 0x54..0x57 of the FUN_0803fe04 0x14-byte record (SRAM 0x53..0x66); record consumed by FUN_0800a380 after func_0x0803fe04 load.
fields.name: record_tag

fields.description: Primary 16-bit counter of the player record (baseline 0x3812 = 14354).
fields.evidence: u16 at record offset +5 (SRAM 0x58) inside the FUN_0803fe04-validated 0x10-byte data window (checksum sum8 over 0x53..0x62 == 0x51 stored at 0x63).
fields.name: record_value_main

fields.description: Secondary 32-bit counter of the player record (fresh save: 0).
fields.evidence: u32 at record offset +7 (SRAM 0x5A) inside the FUN_0803fe04-validated data window; zeroed with the record by func_0x08097fd0 on checksum failure.
fields.name: record_counter_b

fields.description: Tertiary 32-bit counter of the player record (fresh save: 0).
fields.evidence: u32 at record offset +11 (SRAM 0x5E) inside the FUN_0803fe04-validated data window; zeroed with the record by func_0x08097fd0 on checksum failure.
fields.name: record_counter_c

fields.description: Trailing byte of the 16-byte record data window (fresh save: 0x00).
fields.evidence: Byte at record offset +15 (SRAM 0x62), last byte covered by the FUN_0803f9a4 sum8 check in FUN_0803fe04.
fields.name: record_counter_d

fields.description: Stored sum8 checksum: low byte equals sum of record bytes 0x53..0x62 (0x51); high bytes zero.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803fe04 compares *(uint *)(buf+0x10) against (FUN_0803f9a4(buf,0x10,0) & 0xff); baseline sum is 0x51 and stored u32 is 0x00000051.
fields.name: record_checksum
